text.en: Atlas steam-engine design study, 2026-10-27 (docs/52 §§1.2, 3.3–4; full derivation in this topic’s data/SOURCES.md). An independent mechanism study after the preserved 1788 Lap engine, not a museum digital twin or a historical performance record. REF: bore 0.47625 m (ASME, S3), stroke 1.2192 m (S3/S4), flywheel diameter 4.8768 m (Hulse, S5); catalogue bore 0.4572 m (S4) is retained as a disagreement. DESIGN: piston rod diameter 0.04 m; radial display clearance 0.003 m; piston radius 0.235125 m and thickness 0.05 m; cylinder working length about 1.5 m; boiler radius 0.6 m and length 2.2 m; main pipe radius 0.05 m; valve lift 0.015 m. All other geometry, pipes, supports, layout and cameras are reconstructed. Seven controls: experiment pressure/mechanism/governor/energy; cold-pressure 20/50/80 kPa abs; prescribed cycle-rate 8/10/12 cycles/min; governor-rpm 60/90/120; work-share 10/20/30 per 100 heat-input units; motion-mode manual/auto; phase-deg 0/90/180/270/360. Fifteen complete table rows: nine pressure/rate combinations, three governor positions, three energy accounts. Pressure: A=πD²/4, Ar=πd²/4, F(top,bottom)=1000[top(A−Ar)+101.325Ar−bottom A] N, D=0.47625, d=0.04, hot=110 kPa abs. Fd=F(110,cold), Fu=−F(cold,110); W=(Fd+Fu)×1.2192/1000 kJ, Pi=W×rate/60 kW. Newcomen comparison has no through-cover rod: Fn=(101.325−cold)A kN. Default SIM: 16.0216400043 kN down, 15.9303453218 kN up, 38.9558605096 kJ indicated work/cycle, 6.4926434183 kW model indicated power, 14.4871824859 kN Newcomen comparison. Governor: L=0.5 m, g=9.81 m/s², ω=2πn/60, c=g/(Lω²), r=L√(1−c²), angle=acos(c), collar rise h=2L(1−c). Fork J=(0,h), throttle axis T=(1,0), TM=0.4 m, JM=1.1 m; positive-branch circle intersection gives M; ψ=atan2(My,Mx−1), ψ90=−2.814149273102258, u=0.5+(ψ−ψ90)/(π/2), disc angle=90u degrees. At 60/90/120 rpm, h=0.5030195942/0.7791198197/0.8757548986 m and opening=84.9240350/50/36.2631584 %. Three instantaneous rigid poses, no dynamic feedback. Energy: Qh=100 normalized units, W=10/20/30, Qc=100−W; a complete working-fluid cycle obeys Qh=W+Qc. Mechanism: fixed-branch circle intersections close the links; A=(0,0), O=(2.5,−3), F=(−2.5,−0.8), beam half-length 2.5 m, drive rod 3 m, orbit 0.6092838281609874 m, short links 0.8 m, radius/bottom links 1.25 m, piston rod 2.4 m, pump rod 4.5 m. Origin=(0,5.6,0). Planet follows drive-rod angle δp; sun/shaft/flywheel angle=2θ−δp. Equal 48-tooth gears are DESIGN (20° pressure angle, module orbit/48, 0.0003 m total backlash). Stroke is about 1.219200015 m and lateral motion about 1.795 mm in this geometry. Valve pairing follows the sign of piston vertical derivative; derivative magnitude ≤1e−7 m/rad closes all four ports. Flow dots show paths at a display speed of 0.12 m/s, not mass flow.
text.zh: Atlas 蒸汽机设计研究，2026-10-27（docs/52 第1.2、3.3–4节；完整推导见本主题 data/SOURCES.md）。以保存的1788年Lap蒸汽机为参考的独立机构研究，不是馆方数字孪生或历史性能记录。参考：内径0.47625米（ASME，S3）、行程1.2192米（S3/S4）、飞轮直径4.8768米（Hulse，S5）；另保留档案内径0.4572米（S4）的差异。设计：活塞杆直径0.04米、径向显示间隙0.003米、活塞半径0.235125米/厚0.05米、汽缸工作内长约1.5米、锅炉半径0.6米/长2.2米、主管半径0.05米、阀芯升程0.015米。其余几何、管路、支架、布局和镜头均为重建。七控件：experiment为pressure/mechanism/governor/energy；冷侧20/50/80千帕绝压；给定周期率8/10/12周期/分；调速器60/90/120转/分；每100份输入热量中功占10/20/30份；manual/auto；相位0/90/180/270/360度。完整15行表：压力与周期率9行、静态调速3行、能量3行。压力算式：A=πD²/4，Ar=πd²/4，F(上,下)=1000[上(A−Ar)+101.325Ar−下A]牛，D=0.47625、d=0.04、热侧110千帕绝压。Fd=F(110,冷)，Fu=−F(冷,110)；W=(Fd+Fu)×1.2192/1000千焦，Pi=W×周期率/60千瓦。纽科门比较模块无穿盖杆：Fn=(101.325−冷)A千牛。默认模拟：向下16.0216400043千牛、向上15.9303453218千牛、每周期指示功38.9558605096千焦、模型指示功率6.4926434183千瓦；纽科门比较14.4871824859千牛。调速器：L=0.5米、g=9.81米/秒²，ω=2πn/60，c=g/(Lω²)，r=L√(1−c²)，角=acos(c)，滑套升程h=2L(1−c)。叉环J=(0,h)、阀轴T=(1,0)、柄TM=0.4米、杆JM=1.1米；两圆正分支交点给M；ψ=atan2(My,Mx−1)，ψ90=−2.814149273102258，u=0.5+(ψ−ψ90)/(π/2)，阀片角=90u度。60/90/120转/分对应h=0.5030195942/0.7791198197/0.8757548986米，开度84.9240350/50/36.2631584%。三档刚性姿态瞬切，不算动态反馈。能量：工作流体完整循环Qh=W+Qc，Qh=100归一化单位，W=10/20/30、Qc=100−W。机构以固定分支两圆交点闭合：A=(0,0)、O=(2.5,−3)、F=(−2.5,−0.8)、横梁半长2.5米、传动杆3米、轨道半径0.6092838281609874米、短连杆0.8米、摇杆/下杆1.25米、活塞杆2.4米、泵杆4.5米，原点=(0,5.6,0)。行星轮随传动杆转角δp，太阳轮/轴/飞轮角=2θ−δp。相等48齿轮是设计值（压力角20度、模数orbit/48、总侧隙0.0003米）。本几何行程约1.219200015米、横移约1.795毫米。按活塞竖向导数正负配汽，导数绝对值≤1e−7米/弧度时四口全关。流点以显示速度0.12米/秒标路径，不代表质量流量。

note.en: DESIGN/SIM, not measurements. Independent applications of S8/S10/S15/S16, with historical references S2–S7. No pressure-derived acceleration, friction, inertia, leakage, cutoff expansion, pump-work deduction, real efficiency, shaft power, fuel consumption, temperature prediction, load response or governor belt ratio. The throttle opening is geometry, not a flow percentage. The energy boundary is heat transferred to the working fluid, not fuel energy. Original CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; no CC BY-SA inputs. A repository-relative SOURCES.md URL is not emitted because the source schema only accepts HTTP(S).
note.zh: 设计/模拟，不是测量。独立应用S8/S10/S15/S16，历史参考S2–S7。不按压力求加速度，不计摩擦、惯性、泄漏、截止膨胀或泵功；不预测真实效率、轴功率、耗煤、温度、负载响应或调速皮带比。节流开度是几何量，不是流量百分比。能量边界是传给工作流体的热量，不是燃料能。原创CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，无CC BY-SA输入。来源schema只接受HTTP(S)，故不输出仓库相对SOURCES.md网址。

text.en: Science Museum Group, Rotative Steam Engine by Boulton and Watt, 1788. Collection object 1861-46: description, Details and Rights. The preserved Lap engine drove polishing machinery; double action, parallel motion and sun-and-planet gearing are described.
text.zh: 科学博物馆集团《博尔顿与瓦特旋转蒸汽机，1788年》。馆号1861-46：说明、Details与Rights。保存的Lap蒸汽机用于驱动磨光机械；说明双作用、平行运动和太阳与行星齿轮机构。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Title/made/maker/details metadata CC0; descriptive text CC BY 4.0, credited and independently rewritten for Atlas in EN and ZH. Photographs have separate CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms and are not reproduced or traced. No absolute “first” claim adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。标题/年代/制造者/Details元数据为CC0；说明文字CC BY 4.0，署名并为Atlas独立改写成英汉文。照片另有CC BY-NC-SA 4.0条款，本主题不复制或描摹。不采用无条件的“第一”说法。

text.en: R. S. Hartenberg / ASME, Boulton and Watt Rotative Steam Engine, landmark 111 brochure (1986). PDF p.7 of 8, final Lap-engine paragraphs: bore 18.75 in, stroke 4 ft; p.2 explains the Newcomen pressure stroke and weighted return.
text.zh: R. S. Hartenberg / ASME《博尔顿与瓦特旋转蒸汽机》地标111手册（1986）。PDF第7页末Lap段：内径18.75英寸、行程4英尺；第2页解释纽科门压力行程与重泵杆回程。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27, full Lap paragraph with preceding Whitbread context. Facts independently restated; no PDF images reused. Its 296 flywheel-rim teeth disagree with S5’s 304; neither count is modelled. No adjacent Whitbread dimensions or historical efficiency guess adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取，核完整Lap段及前方Whitbread上下文。独立转述事实，不复用PDF图像。其飞轮外缘296齿与S5的304齿不符，模型不选定其中一个。不采用相邻Whitbread尺寸或历史效率猜测。

text.en: Library of Birmingham / Archives of Soho, Matthew Boulton, Lap Engine, Soho Manufactory, 1788, 1790. Catalogue MS 3147/5/714/b, Description: 18 in cylinder, 4 ft stroke, parallel motion.
text.zh: 伯明翰图书馆/Soho档案《Matthew Boulton，Lap Engine，Soho Manufactory，1788、1790》。目录MS 3147/5/714/b的Description：18英寸汽缸、4英尺行程、平行运动机构。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. The 18 in bore differs from S3’s 18.75 in; no cause inferred. Catalogue factual reference only: no underlying scans downloaded and no reproduction rights asserted. Catalogue horsepower is not used.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。18英寸内径与S3的18.75英寸不同，不推测原因。只作目录事实参考；没有下载档案扫描，不声称有复制权。不采用目录马力值。

text.en: David K. Hulse, The Lap Engine, first-person model-reconstruction account. Flywheel and original-floor discussion: flywheel diameter 16 ft.
text.zh: David K. Hulse《The Lap Engine》，作者第一手模型重建研究。飞轮和原地板位置段：飞轮直径16英尺。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Diameter explicitly attributed to Hulse, not a new museum measurement. His 304 rim teeth disagree with ASME’s 296; the outer tooth ring is omitted. Copyrighted photographs/drawings are neither copied nor traced.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。直径明确归属Hulse，不称馆方新测量。其外缘304齿与ASME的296齿不同，模型省略精确外齿圈。不复制或描摹受保护照片/图纸。

text.en: Eugene S. Ferguson / Smithsonian Institution, Kinematics of Mechanisms from the Time of Watt (1962), James Watt, Kinematic Synthesist; figs.7e and 10 and adjacent text. Fig.10 reprints Lardner 1852; fig.7e reprints Muirhead 1854.
text.zh: Eugene S. Ferguson / 史密森学会《从瓦特时代起的机构运动学》（1962），James Watt, Kinematic Synthesist节；图7e、10及邻文。图10转自Lardner 1852，图7e转自Muirhead 1854。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27; both local historical diagrams visually inspected. A/F are separate fixed pivots; the crossing is not a joint. The planet is fixed to the rod; equal gears give two net output turns per complete cycle. Production uses the described centre link, not the early ring guide. Selected nineteenth-century figures are public domain; this is not a blanket licence for other photographs in the book. No Gutenberg marks reproduced.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取，并目视核查两张本地历史图。A/F为不同固定支点，交叉不连接；行星轮固定在杆上，相等齿轮每完整周期净输出两圈。生产采用文中定距连杆，不采用早期环导向。选定十九世纪图为公有领域，不把书中其他照片一概当作公有领域。不复制Gutenberg标识。

text.en: Dionysius Lardner, with additions by James Renwick, The Steam Engine (1836), §§49–53 (jet condenser, air pump, hot well and feed), §§55–60 (double action, links, gearing, flywheel, governor and paired valves); boiler chapter §73 onward.
text.zh: Dionysius Lardner著、James Renwick增补《蒸汽机》（1836），第49–53节（喷射冷凝器、抽气泵、热井和给水）、55–60节（双作用、连杆、齿轮、飞轮、调速器和配对阀）；锅炉章第73节起。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Public-domain historical mechanisms independently restated. Excludes outdated heat theory, civilisational hierarchy and unqualified perfect-speed language. Flywheel wording uses modern energy terms, without a simulated angular acceleration. The source’s collar-lever arrangement does not determine S1’s collar-rise direction. No text or Gutenberg marks copied.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。独立转述公有领域历史机构，不采用过时热学、文明等级措辞或无条件完全恒速断言。飞轮以现代能量用语表述，但不声称求了角加速度。原书套环杠杆配置不决定S1的滑套上升方向。不复制原文或Gutenberg标识。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center, Air Pressure, Definition and Magnitude of Pressure Force: P=F/A and pressure force normal to a surface.
text.zh: NASA格伦研究中心《空气压强》，Definition和Magnitude of Pressure Force段：P=F/A，压力力沿表面法向。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Independent opposing-face and exposed-rod force analysis is S1’s derivation; the page does not give this engine’s forces. US government explanatory text; no image copied.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。两侧及外露杆的受力分析为S1独立推导，原页未给这台蒸汽机的力。美国政府原理说明，不复制图片。

text.en: NOAA / National Weather Service JetStream, The Hydrologic Cycle, Condensation: water vapour becomes liquid and releases heat.
text.zh: NOAA/美国国家气象局JetStream《水循环》，Condensation段：水蒸气变成液体并放热。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Phase-change principle only; no weather figure, machine-temperature calculation or unverified boiling-point extension. US government explanatory text independently restated.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。只采用物态变化原理，不复用天气图，不计算机器温度，不延伸未核的沸点说法。独立转述美国政府原理说明。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center, Conservation of Energy, Derivation: internal-energy change equals heat added minus work done, ΔE=Q−W.
text.zh: NASA格伦研究中心《能量守恒》，Derivation段：内能变化等于输入热量减去做功，ΔE=Q−W。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. For a complete working-fluid cycle ΔE=0, so Qh=W+Qc is the explicitly identified S1 inference. The page is not evidence of Lap efficiency or the chosen 100-unit shares. No image copied.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。工作流体完整循环ΔE=0，故Qh=W+Qc，明确为S1推导。原页不能证明Lap效率或本研究100份的分配。不复制图片。

text.en: Science Museum Group, Newcomen Atmospheric Engine, description and dates. Distinguishes the practical mine-pumping milestone near Dudley in 1712 from the preserved 1791 engine.
text.zh: 科学博物馆集团《纽科门大气式蒸汽机》，说明与年代。区分1712年Dudley附近实用矿井抽水机节点与保存的1791年机器。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Condensation lowers pressure; atmosphere pushes down; the weighted pump side helps return. No universal claim about which pump stroke discharges water. CC0 metadata, CC BY 4.0 descriptions: credited, independently rewritten; no photographs used.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。凝结降压，大气下推，重泵杆一侧帮助回程；不概括所有泵在哪个行程排水。元数据CC0、说明CC BY 4.0；署名、独立改写，不使用照片。

text.en: Ben Russell / Science Museum, James Watt and the separate condenser (5 January 2019), patent-date and separate-vessel discussion: patent 5 January 1769; separate hot cylinder and cold condenser.
text.zh: Ben Russell / 科学博物馆《James Watt and the separate condenser》（2019-01-05），专利日及独立容器段：1769-01-05专利，热汽缸与冷凝器分开。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Independently restated facts only. No general coal-saving percentage, images or quotations adopted.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。只独立转述事实；不采用通用节煤百分比、图片或逐字引文。

text.en: Science Museum Group, James Watt, biography: working model in 1765; commercial engines installed and working in 1776.
text.zh: 科学博物馆集团《James Watt》生平：1765年工作模型；1776年商用机器已安装运转。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Narrow milestones only, rather than a single date when the whole rotative machine was invented. CC BY 4.0 descriptive text credited and independently rewritten; no images copied.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。只采用明确节点，不把整套旋转蒸汽机归于一个发明日。说明文字CC BY 4.0，署名、独立改写，不复制图片。

text.en: Atlas local topic and artwork provenance audit, 2026-10-27: published energy-conversion and states-of-matter topic frontmatter and four target chapter IDs; three approved final steam-engine PNG files and their manifest.
text.zh: Atlas本地主题与插图来源核查，2026-10-27：energy-conversion与states-of-matter发布状态及四个目标章节ID；三张获准最终steam-engine PNG及manifest。

note.en: Local audit only, no runtime URL. The cover and condenser PNGs are byte-identical to industrial-revolution parent-art-snapshot copies. Final parallel-motion image selected after rejecting an extra hinge in the first attempt. Approved hashes, files, export method and limitations are recorded in data/SOURCES.md. Original CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; no historical photographic asset is embedded.
note.zh: 仅本地核查，不提供运行时URL。封面与冷凝器PNG与industrial-revolution的parent-art-snapshot逐字节相同。平行运动图第一稿多出铰链，已弃用，采用最终稿。获准哈希、文件、导出方法与限制列于data/SOURCES.md。原创CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，不嵌入历史照片。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center, Work Equals Force Times Distance, constant-force and displacement-component paragraphs: W=Fs for aligned constant force; J=N·m; power is the rate of doing work.
text.zh: NASA格伦研究中心《功等于力乘距离》，常力及沿位移分量段：恒定且沿位移的力有W=Fs；焦耳=牛·米；功率为做功快慢。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27. Work definition and independent S1 indicated-work calculation; no aircraft illustration copied. The model’s indicated power is not shaft power.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取。用于功的定义及S1独立指示功计算，不复制飞机图。模型指示功率不是轴功率。

text.en: NIST, SI Units – Length, metric redefinition of the inch; Guide to the SI, Appendix B conversion factors. Exact definitions: 1 in=0.0254 m; 1 ft=0.3048 m.
text.zh: NIST《SI单位——长度》英寸公制重定义段；《SI指南》附录B换算系数。精确定义：1英寸=0.0254米，1英尺=0.3048米。

note.en: Read 2026-10-27; companion https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811/nist-guide-si-appendix-b-conversion-factors. Independently converts 18.75 in→0.47625 m, 18 in→0.4572 m, 4 ft→1.2192 m, 16 ft→4.8768 m. Exact unit definitions do not add significant figures to historical measurements. No NIST artwork copied.
note.zh: 2026-10-27读取；另核https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811/nist-guide-si-appendix-b-conversion-factors。独立换算18.75英寸→0.47625米、18英寸→0.4572米、4英尺→1.2192米、16英尺→4.8768米。单位定义精确不代表历史测量多出有效位数。不复制NIST插图。
